andhra-pradesh.intro: Eastern Ghats coffee hills, a 974 km coastline, the Godavari and Krishna deltas, Rayalaseema's canyons and forts, and some of India's oldest Buddhist sites.

trails.note: Five Shiva temples said to hold pieces of one lingam; devotees try to visit all five in a day.

trails.name: Araku and the Eastern Ghats
trails.note: Coffee estates, caves, waterfalls and cloud-sea sunrises above Vizag.

trails.name: Buddhist coast
trails.note: 2,000-year-old monasteries and stupas along the old sea-trade route, from Srikakulam to the Krishna.

trails.name: Godavari by boat and road
trails.note: The river's gorge, its widest stretch and the coconut delta to the sea.

trails.name: Tirupati temple circuit
trails.note: Tirumala and the shrines, arch and fort around it.

trails.name: Rayalaseema forts and canyons
trails.note: Hill forts and the Pennar gorge across the dry southwest.

trails.name: Vijayanagara art
trails.note: Murals, carved pillars and temple towns from the 15th–16th centuries.

trails.name: Monsoon waterfalls
trails.note: Best from July to November, when the falls run full.

trails.name: Birds and wetlands
trails.note: Pelicans, flamingos and storks, mostly November to March.

trails.name: Tirupati beyond Tirumala
trails.note: The temples, falls and forest shrines most pilgrims miss.

trails.name: Konaseema temples and sweets
trails.note: Coconut-delta temple towns, with stops for pootharekulu and kaja.

trails.name: Vizag coast and hills
trails.note: Beaches, hilltops and the red dunes on the road to Bheemili.

trails.name: Vijayawada caves and hills
trails.note: Rock-cut caves and hill temples around the Krishna in one city.

trails.name: Handloom and craft villages
trails.note: Where Andhra's famous saris, toys and textiles are still made by hand.

festivals.name: Sankranti in Konaseema
festivals.about: The big harvest festival; Konaseema villages carry decorated prabhalas across fields and canals on Kanuma day.

festivals.name: Flamingo Festival
festivals.about: Celebration of the winter flamingos and pelicans of Pulicat and Nelapattu.

festivals.name: Maha Shivaratri at Kotappakonda
festivals.about: Towering decorated prabhalu are brought to the hill temple through the night.

festivals.name: Ugadi
festivals.about: Telugu New Year, with ugadi pachadi and temple visits across the state.

festivals.name: Dasara at Kanaka Durga
festivals.about: Ten days of worship on Indrakeeladri, ending with a river procession on the Krishna.

festivals.name: Tirumala Brahmotsavam
festivals.about: Nine-day festival of grand processions around the Tirumala temple.

arunachal-pradesh.intro: Snow passes and Monpa monasteries in the west, Apatani rice valleys in the middle, and the Siang, Dibang and Lohit valleys running east to India's first sunrise. Indian visitors need an Inner Line Permit; foreigners need a Protected Area Permit.

trails.note: Arunachal's classic drive: orchards, a 4,000 m pass, war memorials and the great monastery.

trails.name: Monasteries of Monyul
trails.note: Gompas, a nunnery and stupas across the Monpa homeland.

trails.name: Ziro valley days
trails.note: Apatani villages, rice-fish fields and pine ridges at an easy pace.

trails.name: Siang heartland
trails.note: From temple ruins on the plains to the river towns of the Adi and Galo.

trails.name: Lohit to India's first sunrise

trails.note: Second World War history on the road to the Myanmar border.

trails.note: The Three Valleys and Nyishi hill towns of East Kameng.

festivals.name: Parshuram Kund Mela
festivals.about: Thousands of pilgrims bathe in the Lohit at Parshuram Kund.

festivals.name: Reh
festivals.about: The main festival of the Idu Mishmi, centred on Roing.

festivals.about: Galo festival of plenty, with white rice-paste faces and dances.

festivals.about: Tai Khamti water festival and Buddhist new year in Namsai.

festivals.name: Dree
festivals.about: Apatani agricultural festival praying for a good harvest.

festivals.name: Solung
festivals.about: The Adi community's biggest festival, with the Ponung dance.

festivals.name: Ziro Festival of Music
festivals.about: Open-air independent music festival in the rice fields of Ziro.

festivals.name: Orange Festival of Adventure and Music
festivals.about: Music, adventure sports and orange orchards in Dambuk.

assam.intro: The Brahmaputra valley of rhinos, tea and river islands: Kaziranga and Manas, the satras of Majuli, the Ahom capitals around Sivasagar, Guwahati's hill temples and the blue hills of Dima Hasao.

trails.note: Hill temples, a river-island shrine, the best museums and a sunset on the Brahmaputra.

trails.name: Across the river from Guwahati
trails.note: Temples, silk looms and sculpted ruins on the north bank.

trails.note: Myths of Usha and Aniruddha and Assam's oldest sculpture, then the Jia Bhoroli.

trails.name: Majuli satras

bihar.intro: Where the Buddha found enlightenment and Mahavira was born: Bodh Gaya, Nalanda, Rajgir and Vaishali, Mauryan Pataliputra, Sher Shah's Sasaram, Mithila's painters and the Ganga's river dolphins.

trails.name: The Buddhist circuit

trails.name: Patna in a day
trails.note: Mauryan ruins, a beehive granary, two great museums and the Ganga at dusk.

trails.name: Rajgir and Nalanda
trails.note: Hills, hot springs and the ruins of the world's most famous ancient university.

trails.name: Jain Bihar
trails.note: Places tied to the life of Mahavira.

trails.name: Sher Shah country
trails.note: Sher Shah's lake tomb, a giant hill fort and the Kaimur's monsoon falls.

trails.name: Champaran
trails.note: Gandhi's first satyagraha, Ashokan pillars and Bihar's tiger reserve.

trails.name: Mithila
trails.note: Painting villages, palaces of the Darbhanga raj and Sita's birthplace.

trails.name: Down the Ganga
trails.note: Forts, yoga, river dolphins and silk along Bihar's eastern Ganga.

trails.name: Mithila

festivals.name: Makar Mela, Rajgir

festivals.name: Buddha Purnima
festivals.about: Monks and pilgrims from across Asia gather at the Mahabodhi Temple.

chhattisgarh.intro: India's widest waterfall, Bastar's caves, haats and dhokra craft, the early temples of Sirpur, Tala and Bhoramdeo, sal-forest tiger reserves and the Tibetan plateau of Mainpat. Check local advice before travelling deep into south Bastar.

trails.name: Crafts of Chhattisgarh
trails.note: Bell metal, iron craft and silk.

trails.name: Jashpur hills

festivals.name: Sirpur National Dance and Music Festival

festivals.name: Navratri at Dongargarh
festivals.when: Chaitra and Ashwin Navratri, spring and autumn
festivals.about: Huge crowds climb to the Bamleshwari temple through the night.

festivals.name: Hareli

goa.intro: Beaches from Querim to Polem, the UNESCO churches of Old Goa, Ponda's temple belt, Fontainhas and the grand houses of Salcete, and Western Ghats forests with Dudhsagar's four-tiered falls.

gujarat.intro: The white salt desert of Kutch and its craft villages, Gir's Asiatic lions, Somnath and Dwarka, Harappan Dholavira and Lothal, the stepwells and Solanki temples of the north, UNESCO-listed old Ahmedabad and Champaner, and Gandhi's ashram.
